prompt: A single excretor, a bull-sized alien grazer that browses poisoned ruined ground and slowly concentrates the metals and salts it eats, drawn as a game sprite for RimWorld in a painterly, realistic vanilla RimWorld style with a thin clean dark outline and a transparent background. It is plainly not an Earth animal and not a bison: it has no fur at all. Its hide is thick, leathery slate-blue-grey skin armoured with overlapping, cracked mineral plates along the back, crusted with pale salt nodules and streaked with rust-orange and verdigris-green stains where metals leach out. Its low, wedge-shaped head carries exactly three horns: two thick, ridged horns curving outward and forward from the skull and a third, straight, pointed horn rising from the middle of the brow between them, all three dark bone tipped with pale salt crust, and all three always visible. It has a broad, flat, scoop-like lip-plate for scraping the ground, small deep-set glowing amber eyes, and a heavy swollen belly. Along each flank runs a row of knobbly, translucent amber gland sacs where dense, layered metal-salt pellets form. It stands on four thick, pillar-like legs ending in broad split hooves, all bearing its weight in a natural standing pose, with a short, thick tail ending in a rough mineral knob. One animal with consistent proportions, colour, horn count and rendering. A single centred subject on a transparent background, with no ground and no text.
